entities.name: Agata Mróz-Olszewska
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Agata Danuta Mróz-Olszewska was a Polish volleyball player, a member of the Poland women's national volleyball team in 1997–2007, double European Champion. She died of an infection following a bone marrow transplant to treat Myelodysplastic syndrome, which she had suffered from since the age of 17.

entities.summary: Agata Danuta Mróz-Olszewska was a Polish volleyball player, a member of the Poland women's national volleyball team in 1997–2007, double European Champion. She died of an infection following a bone marrow transplant to treat Myelodysplastic syndrome, which she had suffered from since the age of 17.
